figures.caption: The certified contract links exact factor-coded model data and complete orthogonal packet families to cached gain search, an outward-rounded verifier, a Gaussian Wasserstein guarantee, and parameter intervals. Arrows summarize theorem dependencies, rather than a timing diagram.
figures.scope: Schematic theorem chain; fixed finite-dimensional, one-observation model.

figures.caption: The coordinate prior has covariance diag(4,1). The chosen Gaussian posterior version has mean (2/3,1/6) and covariance [[4/3,-2/3],[-2/3,5/6]]. Contours are one standard-deviation level sets, not confidence regions. Observation noise has variance one, so the dashed observation relation is not a support constraint.
figures.scope: Numerical contour rendering from exact rational matrices; no interval-certified curve.

figures.caption: The rank-one prior and chosen Gaussian posterior are supported on x₁=x₂; the posterior covariance is P/3. The supplied observation y=(1,-1) lies in the complementary direction and produces posterior mean zero. The plotted finite segments mark two latent standard deviations, rather than the full unbounded support.
figures.scope: Singular law is supported on a line; finite segments illustrate scale only.

figures.caption: The coordinate output projectors select the first and second coordinates. Their residual components are orthogonal and their squared Frobenius energies add exactly to the full residual energy. Input packet splitting is trivial in this one-dimensional observation space.
figures.scope: Exact matrices and exact energy identity at the coordinate initial gain.

figures.caption: The cached coordinate trajectory alternates labels 0,1,0,1,0,1. Only the selected packet changes at each step. After six updates the packet energies are 16/117649 and 1/117649, and total residual energy is 17/117649.
figures.scope: Exact trajectory values; logarithmic display uses numerical coordinates.

figures.caption: The coordinate gain path has horizontal updates for packet 0 and vertical updates for packet 1. The exact optimal gain K=(2/3,1/6) is shown as a reference. The returned gain is the sixth exact greedy iterate, rather than an independent minimizer computation.
figures.scope: Exact greedy iterates; K obtained by independent rational inversion for this example.

figures.caption: The first cached update adds τG₀ to the gain, multiplies G₀ by T, and replaces its energy. G₁ and e₁ are reused without recomputation. Total energy is updated by 17−16+16/49=65/49.
figures.scope: Exact cache state transition. Initialization computes the full residual once.

figures.caption: The uniform greedy rate is r=85/98 for this two-packet coordinate model. The exact score starts at 34 and ends at 34/117649. The theorem bound rⁿ·34 is valid but much looser here. The large sufficient fuel 410093 is a guaranteed horizon, rather than the observed six-update count or a tight estimate.
figures.scope: Uniform contraction theorem illustrated on a finite exact trajectory.

figures.caption: Cached search stops when exact score is at most ε²/4. At the returned coordinate gain, exact score is 34/117649 and the rounded score at precision 12 is 481/1048576. Both are below ε²=1/400. A sufficient fallback allows another ε²/4 inflation, leaving the rounded score at most ε²/2.
figures.scope: Exact stopping margin and actual successful rounded-verifier score.

figures.caption: Down-rounding 1/3 to four fractional bits gives center 5/16. Up-rounding the lost magnitude gives radius 1/16, so the ball is [1/4,3/8] and contains 1/3. This is center/radius fixed-point arithmetic with unbounded mathematical integer parts, rather than an IEEE-754 format.
figures.scope: Hand-computable exact dyadic enclosure; no floating-point error claim.

figures.caption: The final coordinate gain is evaluated at precisions 1 through 16. Probe 4 gives score 25/16 and fails; probe 12 gives 481/1048576 and passes. The theorem-backed conservative fallback precision is 72. The observed shape is fixture-specific and is not a new claim that every precision curve is strictly decreasing.
figures.scope: Exact rational verifier scores; fixed gain, fixed rounded computation graph.

figures.caption: The final coordinate Joseph covariance differs from the exact posterior covariance by [[16,4],[4,1]]/705894, a positive semidefinite rank-one matrix. The panels show decimal renderings of exact entries. The covariance excess is an exact algebraic identity and is not itself the Wasserstein distance.
figures.scope: Exact identity independently checked via direct Joseph factors and rational inverse.

figures.caption: Each horizontal interval is centered at the reported dyadic center, translated relative to the exact Joseph parameter and rescaled by 2³² for visibility. The dashed zero line is enclosed in all six intervals. These enclose the approximation parameters at B₆, not entrywise parameters of the exact posterior. The centers alone do not define another certified Gaussian.
figures.scope: Exact interval comparisons; graphical coordinates are numerical rescalings.

figures.caption: The rotated output projectors are Q₊=[[1,1],[1,1]]/2 and Q₋=[[1,-1],[-1,1]]/2. The initial residual lies entirely in Q₊. Consequently the greedy solver selects packet 0 four times, and active energy is multiplied by 4/25 at each update.
figures.scope: Exact rotated packet geometry and four-update trajectory.

figures.caption: The finite scan compares the current incumbent energy with each visited label and replaces it only on a strict increase. Equal energies preserve the incumbent. Both labels must occur somewhere in the supplied scan; arbitrary order and duplicates are accepted. The table gives three independently checked exact examples.
figures.scope: Exact selection rules; a maximum is guaranteed by complete scan coverage.

figures.caption: For the scalar model, τ=1/3 and the ideal first update has gain and residual both 1/3. Independently rounding both to zero fractional bits produces stored gain zero and stored residual zero. The cached score reports zero, although the true residual remains one and true score is two. The final independent verifier rejects this candidate for ε=1/10.
figures.scope: Checked scalar counterexample to center-only rounded-cache invariants.

figures.caption: The released selective updates use exact rationals, while the final verifier and parameter output use outward-rounded dyadic balls. A separate illustration shows why covariance centers cannot automatically be treated as a covariance: a PSD rank-one covariance rounds downward to a matrix with quadratic witness −1. This counterexample concerns center-only interpretation, not failure of the enclosing interval arrays.
figures.scope: Exact arithmetic contract and independent covariance-center counterexample.

figures.caption: The canonical exact cached selective solver is separate from the recomputed selective benchmark mode and the earlier rounded full-gain branch. Cached and recomputed selective modes share the same greedy trajectory and stopping margin. The rounded full-gain branch does not supply a proof for independently rounded selective caches.
figures.scope: Branch distinction; no unsupported rounded-selective implementation is claimed.

figures.caption: Archived benchmark producer medians use five repetitions after warmup. Cached iteration is cheaper than recomputed selective iteration, but these seven cases do not establish an overall advantage over efficient full Richardson updates. The right panel adds a producer median, one export measurement and one Lean-check measurement; this is an accounting estimate rather than a sampled end-to-end latency distribution. Common clean dependency build cost is excluded.
figures.scope: Archived September 2026 timings; no fresh speed, BLAS/GPU, or scalability claim.

figures.caption: The assurance map distinguishes the Gaussian law and Wasserstein mathematics, the typed formal solver and rounded evaluator, fresh finite publication checks, and execution extensions. Equality to a canonical Bayesian posterior is evidence-almost everywhere, while the explicit chosen Gaussian posterior version has pointwise formula semantics. Fresh Python checks do not rerun the Lean kernel, and no universal parser, hardware floating-point, executable sampling or sequential filtering contract is included.
figures.scope: Scope map, with archived formal evidence separated from fresh finite diagnostics.
